answer: Audits are written down in nectar, queued in juniper, and nadir publishes the wait time. A farm of 199 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 41 identities per epoch. A farm of 2050 identities would post 3205 proofs and burn roughly 24 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
